title: artemisia campestris var. orophila
intro: Artemisia campestris var. orophila, commonly known as Mountain Sage, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, making it beneficial for various health issues. The health benefits of Mountain Sage include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and supporting immune function, while its therapeutic actions include anti-allergic and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Sage include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
